items.title: Chink Martin Interview, 1966-10-19
items.q: I was waking with Johnny Byerstoff at the Tokyo Garden.

ctx.x: Oh, yeah, well you don't have to, you said you weren't going to tell it before it went on anyway. You want to take it off and you tell us something and turn it off.

I was waking with Johnny Byerstoff at the Tokyo Garden. And he, you see, his father used to be a swine in the Sharmogrot. The Sharmogrot of the Sharmogrot. Well, he was one himself. Byerstoffer. Yeah, Byerstoffer, the trumpet player. That was before he went off and he left the city, see. So, naturally his dad had got our band to go and travel all around the country with the Shriners. They had made a tour all around the country with the Shriners, see. So, every time that we would go in a different city, we'd have…
It was a Suzaphone, see. Is that a double B-flat?
